theme: An open day at sea; the list waits for shore.
greeting: No meetings on the calendar today, Dan. The trip home is the only real thread — a few travel bookings want closing from dry land before you land in Florida on Sunday.

needsAttention.title: Lock the Cavtat transfers before you're off the boat
needsAttention.detail: On your travel list: the charter ends around noon Saturday at Komolac, and the transfer to Cavtat, the early Sunday checkout, and the airport taxi all need arranging from shore while you still have signal.

needsAttention.title: Last chance to swap the St Pete Airbnb
needsAttention.detail: The Sept 27 – Oct 5 booking charges tomorrow, Sept 18. If a better option is going to turn up, today is the day to switch before it's paid.

needsAttention.title: Book the rental SUV before you land TPA
needsAttention.detail: You touch down in Tampa Sunday afternoon; the full-size SUV for Sept 20 – Oct 5 still needs booking so you're not at a walk-up counter jet-lagged.

flagged.title: SEC moves to scrap the shareholder-proposal rule
flagged.detail: Responsible Investor leads with the SEC proposing to rescind the longstanding shareholder-proposal rule — squarely your governance beat if you want a skim.

inbox.noise: About 15 unread, all newsletters and shop promos — NYT Cooking, Bloomberg, retail.
inbox.clear: Nothing in the inbox is waiting on a reply from you.

recipe.title: Kabocha squash pie
recipe.why: Autumn brings the first hard squash to the market — sweet, dense, and made for slow baking.

tasks.title: Sort Disney tickets for the Sept 26-27 park weekend
Book the Maine Christmas SUV out of Portland (refundable)

acts.line: Nothing on the calendar — the day is entirely open.
Open water, not a schedule; the travel list is the only thing asking for you.
Cavtat and the flight home are two days out — worth teeing up while you're still reachable.
